Thanks for your interest in CodeSense. We don't accept pull requests yet.

This repository is a release snapshot, synced from private development, so a
pull request can't be merged here. Please open an issue or start a discussion
instead. CONTRIBUTING.md explains the policy:
https://github.com/codesensehq/codesense/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md

Privacy scans inspect every commit, plus branch names and request metadata.
If an earlier commit contains private data that was later removed, start a fresh

**We don't accept pull requests yet.** See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/codesensehq/codesense/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

Once pull requests open:

- [ ] What this changes and why:
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`) under the DCO.
- [ ] Checks I ran (see CONTRIBUTING.md → Local checks):
- [ ] A line under `## [Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`, if users would notice the change.
